# pidginhost_storage_products (Data Source)

Lists the storage products. Use a product's `slug` as the `product` of a `pidginhost_volume`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_storage_products" "all" {}

output "storage_products" {
  value = { for p in data.pidginhost_storage_products.all.products : p.slug => "${p.min_size}-${p.max_size} ${p.unit}" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `products` (Attributes List) The storage products. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--products))

<a id="nestedatt--products"></a>
### Nested Schema for `products`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Product ID.
- `max_size` (Number) Maximum size.
- `min_size` (Number) Minimum size.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `price` (String) Price per unit per month, as a decimal string.
- `slug` (String) Product slug.
- `type` (String) Product type.
- `unit` (String) Billing unit.
